F-gemini.title: Incorrect eviction policy in LRU cache
F-gemini.message: Using `popitem(last=True)` removes the most recently added or updated item instead of the least recently used one.
F-gemini.rationale: Since new/updated items are moved to the end of the `OrderedDict`, the oldest (least recently used) items are at the beginning. Popping with `last=True` discards the item that was just added, defeating the purpose of the cache.
F-gemini.suggestion: Use `self._pages.popitem(last=False)` to evict the least recently used item.

F-gemini.title: Cache hit does not update LRU order
